title: Settings shows whether email sending, the Frequency link and Google Analytics are set up on the machine, and the exact command for each missing piece
description: The Owner wants every person using FlowWeb to have a page and a setting for every function. Three connections are still set up only by reading senders/README.md on the Mac: the email sender (senders/email.json, a mailbox password in the keychain, the sender running), the Frequency link (the outcomes secret crd_frequencyoutcomes) and Google Analytics for paid ads (the flow's ga4 property and its key crd_ga4paidads). Nobody can see from the site which of these is done. fwd answers GET /v1/connections (packages/daemon/src/api/connections.ts) with, for email: settings (the file is readable), mailboxes (address and whether its password is saved), postal, claim_url, claim_secret, last_pass_at, running; for frequency: site (FW_FREQUENCY_URL or null) and outcomes_secret; for ga4: property_id, credential, key and last_pull; each with ready and fix, the exact commands for what is missing, using this machine's FW_HOME. A secret is only checked for presence: the keychain is asked without -w and a creds file is only stat'ed, so no secret value is ever read into the answer. FW_KEYCHAIN=off skips the keychain (tests). The relay mirrors /connections. Settings gets a Connections section (packages/web/src/settings/ConnectionsSettings.tsx): each connection with Ready or Needs setup, what is set, and each fix command with a Copy button; no field takes a secret; when the machine's FlowWeb is older and answers 404, it says to update FlowWeb on that machine. Tokens only. No em dashes.
acceptance: GET /v1/connections reports email, frequency and ga4 from this machine's files, keychain and env, each with ready and fix
A saved secret shows as true and its value never appears in the answer
FW_KEYCHAIN=off keeps the keychain out of the answer
Settings shows each connection as Ready or Needs setup with each fix command and a Copy button, and has no field for a secret
An older fwd answering 404 shows Update FlowWeb on this machine
